title: jamie chen - people ops manager prep q1 2026
content:
Upcoming 1:1 + manager prep notes (Q1 2026)

Quick context:
- Role: Senior People Ops Partner (individual contributor + project lead on hiring programs)
- Focus last quarter: ramping recruiting partnerships, pilot new onboarding flow for Dedicated hires, launching hiring manager training program v0
- Current priorities for next 6-12 weeks: reduce time-to-offer for eng IC roles, stabilize onboarding NPS, run org health pulse post-Dedicated launch

Agenda ideas for sync:
- Quick wins / blockers (5-7 min)
- Progress vs. Q1 goals + evidence (10 min)
- Hiring pipeline health & resourcing ask (10 min)
- Career development / feedback (5 min)
- Decisions / approvals needed (5 min)

Accomplishments (last 90 days) - short bullets I can cite:
- Reduced average time-to-offer for SWE-IC roles from 38 -> 27 days (pilot with new hiring scorecard + interviewer playbook). Still some variance for infra roles.
- Launched onboarding v0 for Dedicated (first cohort = 12 hires) - initial NPS 6.8/10, qualitative notes indicate docs gaps around infra access.
- Rolled out hiring manager training workshop to 24 managers (80% positive feedback). Materials in Confluence: /display/PE/Hiring+Manager+Workshop.
- Partnered with Eng TPMs to create clearer role templates; 6 templates updated and published.

Evidence / metrics I want to bring:
- Time-to-offer by role banding (SWE-L3/L4/L5, infra vs product) - see sheet: HR Hiring Metrics Q1 (linked in Confluence).
- Candidate funnel conversion rates (apply -> screen -> interview -> offer) - drop observed at resume screen for infra.
- Onboarding NPS + top 5 qualitative themes from cohort 1 (docs, infra access, manager check-ins).

Current blockers / risks:
- Infra interviews: not enough calibrated interviewers; interview quality inconsistent - need 2 more dedicated interviewers for infra loop or cross-training plan.
- Onboarding infra access: delayed KMS/credentials for private deployment hires; security-investigation ticket open (SEC-88).
- Hiring forecast: Q2 Dedicated hiring spike expected (approx +15 hires) but we lack clear ramp plan for hiring coordinators.

Asks / decisions for manager:
- Approve headcount for 2 part-time interview trainers (3 months) to stabilize infra loop - rough cost estimate attached in Confluence.
- Support to escalate KMS/credentials priority with Security (SEC-88) - recommend brief sync w/ Ben (Security) this week.
- OK to pilot automated pre-boarding checklist emails (via Lever integrations) for next cohort? I can run a 6-week A/B test.

Career / growth notes (what I want from you):
- Would like mentorship around strategic stakeholder influence (esp. with Platform Eng).
- Short-term stretch: lead Q2 cross-functional onboarding redesign (end-to-end) - need 20% protected time.
- Long-term: move toward manager track in 12-18 months; want to align on skills/gaps.

Feedback I'm seeking from you in the meeting:
- Is the infra interviewer trainer headcount a defensible ask vs. contracting?
- Thoughts on prioritizing onboarding infra access vs. hiring coordinator hires (trade-offs).
- Your view on my readiness for manager track - what single skill should I focus on this quarter?

Notes to self / talking points (short):
- Highlight measurable improvement in time-to-offer (numbers + methodology).
- Emphasize ship of onboarding v0 + clear plan to iterate (v1 metrics).
- Frame headcount ask as risk mitigation for Q2 spike; show cost of unfilled roles vs. short-term trainer hire.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Can we get 15 minutes on Ben's calendar to unblock SEC-88? (Slack thread convo: linked_artifacts)
- Who owns post-offer relocation approvals now that we moved to new vendor? (I think still Finance ops; need a contact)
- Should I draft a short business case for the trainer hire and share before the meeting? (Yes - action item)

Action items before 1:1 (my TODOs):
- Draft 1-page trainer headcount business case + cost/benefit (due: 2026-03-06)
- Pull latest hiring metrics and attach to Confluence (due: 2026-03-05)
- Prepare a 2-slide summary of onboarding v0 NPS + top 3 changes planned (due: 2026-03-05)

Misc snippets / raw lines I might say:
- "We closed the time-to-offer gap for IC roles but infra still lags - this is mostly interviewer capacity and signal calibration."
- "Onboarding v0 proved we can improve new-hire experience without major infra changes; v1 needs clearer infra access flow."
- "Short-term trainer investment will reduce offer fall-through and interviewer rework - ROI in 3 months if we stabilize interviews for infra."

References / links I want to cite quickly in convo:
- Confluence: People Ops Q1 OKRs - https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PE/People+Ops+Q1+OKRs
- Hiring metrics sheet (private): HR Hiring Metrics Q1 (attached in Drive)
- Slack thread about SEC-88: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/CHPeopleOps/p1675000000000000

End of notes.

-- jamie
plain_text_preview: Manager prep notes: accomplishments, metrics to bring, blockers (infra interviews, KMS delays), asks (trainer headcount, escalate SEC-88), action items (business case, metrics pull).
